purpose: Route full local security-audit requests to the security-audit preset, while keeping one-CVE, one-cloud-posture, patch-only, and ordinary review prompts on their focused skills.

cases.prompt: run a full security audit of this repository
scan-fix-rescan this codebase and verify the patch independently
dependency plus IaC audit with scanner receipts before any fix
pre-release security verification with re-scan and independent review
is CVE-2024-12345 reachable in this dependency
cases.assert: routes to cve-reachability-analyzer, not the full security-audit preset

cases.prompt: check whether this AWS account has public S3 buckets
cases.assert: routes to cloud-security-posture-detection, not the full security-audit preset

cases.prompt: write a security patch for this XSS finding only
cases.assert: routes to security-patch-advisor, not the full security-audit preset

cases.prompt: do an ordinary code review of this pull request
cases.assert: routes to code-quality or multi-agent-code-review, not the full security-audit preset
